title: The Wounded Hound
text: The House's hound, which went with the Lost, limps out of the brush whining, one leg dragging, its coat matted with blood. It noses at your hands, then turns to look back the way it came.

options.label: The healer tends the hound so it can lead you to them faster.

outcomes.text: It leads you to them, limping fast.

options.label: Follow it as it is; there is no time to waste.

outcomes.text: It goes slowly, but it knows the way.

options.label: The sharpest tracks its blood back to find what hurt it.

outcomes.text: They find what hurt it, and it is still close.
